title: Ye's Cutout Dove Hoodie
description:
Background: Featuring a Dove designed by Alan Pastrana, this prototype Dove Hoodie has a different Gap Logo and Dove Fabric sewn onto it. Ye didn't like the screenprinting of the GAP Logo on the hoodie, so he had his team take another hoodie and had them sew the GAP logo from that onto another hoodie.

This Hoodie was the reference for the color on all the washed black pieces.

Documented wear by Ye:
• 01/12/2022 on a Night out with Julia Fox
• 01/13/2022 in Los Angeles and in the studio with The Game
• 01/17/2022, in Los Angeles with Fivio Foriegn
